sections.heading: The Fastest JavaScript Data Grid
sections.body_html: Bryntum Grid is a fast, JavaScript table component for the web. Designed for smooth developer experience and user experiences, it integrates easily with React, Angular, and Vue applications.
sections.body_text: Bryntum Grid is a fast, JavaScript table component for the web. Designed for smooth developer experience and user experiences, it integrates easily with React , Angular , and Vue applications.

sections.heading: Feature-Rich
sections.body_html:
Bryntum Grid offers every feature you’d expect from a professional JavaScript grid component, including:

  • Nested grid with a chart
  • Cell editing
  • Custom cell rendering
  • Rows and header grouping
  • Filtering and search functions
  • Tree grid formatting

sections.heading: AI Integration
sections.body_html:
Generate AI content directly in Bryntum Grid cells using a simple formula. Just add your instruction, with an optional reference to the column data, and start benefitting from:

  • AI-powered review insights
  • AI-generated SEO descriptions

sections.heading: Exceptional Performance
sections.body_html:
The web data grid has been optimized for performance at scale, making use of:

  • Virtual rendering
  • Lazy loading of large datasets
  • Minimal DOM interactions
  • Element reuse
  • Modern CSS optimizations

Enjoy rapid loading times and a reliable scrolling experience; try our big data set demo now.

sections.heading: Easily Customizable
sections.body_html:
Bryntum Grid provides many options for customization, so you can easily style your component using:

  • Five preset themes and a custom theme demo
  • Cell renderers for custom HTML and style cells
  • An extensive, reactive API
  • Responsive support for varying screen sizes

sections.heading: 50+ More Widgets
sections.body_html:
Choose from a wide range of UI elements that easily make your app polished and professional:

  • Add buttons, menus, toggles, sliders, and more to cells or headers to let users take quick actions without leaving the grid view.
  • Meet user needs with fewer clicks and less searching.
  • Implement widgets easily with our clear documentation.

sections.heading: Intuitive Interactions
sections.body_html:
Bryntum Grid has a user-friendly interface that’s been thoughtfully designed for navigating advanced use cases with ease.

  • Use nested grids to simplify interacting with complex data structures
  • Manage your view by expanding data as needed with collabsible inline columns
  • Conveniently update data using a docked or inline editor
  • Add a chart to visualize data
